explication: TensorFlow is an end-to-end machine-learning platform with Python and C++ APIs and deployment-oriented runtimes. A typical user path is to call the Python API to define and execute tensor operations, then consume the resulting tensors; the README demonstrates this with `tf.add(...).numpy()`. The sampled C++ session implementation shows graph extension and execution through a session, while other documented capabilities include distributed strategies, SavedModel/checkpoint recovery, Lite conversion, and accelerator integration. Several of those branches are represented from documented scope and repository paths; unsampled implementation links are not asserted.
